_comment: The phase polynomial D*S(U,V,W) of Grothe/Upper/Data.lean (phaseStrs) in its natural Laguerre-angular basis: D*S = sum_t coefficient_t * L_n^{(k)}(3U) * L_m^{(k)}(3V) * Im((conj(z) w)^k), U=|z|^2, V=|w|^2, W=Re(conj(z) w), D=Im(conj(z) w), generalized Laguerre L_n^{(k)}(x) = sum_j (-1)^j C(n+k,n-j) x^j/j!. Taken from the archived source file (laguerre_coefficients); tools/upper_closure_spike.py check-phase verifies the exact polynomial identity with the monomial list phaseStrs of Data.lean. Used by the prototype because the float64 evaluation of the monomial form loses up to 6e-11 relative at bulk points (condition 4e6) while this form is conditioned like 1e1-1e2.
